records.subject: spec-guard-claude-desktop-handoff-display
evidence: host:Claude desktop Code tab, a worktree session of this repository after the plugin update to 0.47.0

result:the phase injection in that session changed from `branch main` and the main checkout (stage DONE, 41 modules) to the session's own branch and worktree (stage BUILDING, 42 modules): the hook input cwd is the worktree, and the root resolution fix takes effect
command:the user typed exactly `/spec-guard:handoff` in that session

result:the desktop app showed a card titled `钩子已阻止您的提示词` with a warning icon; the body was the complete handoff text with line breaks kept, ending in `下一步：____`; the original prompt was not echoed and no model turn ran
result:computer-use cannot be granted access to the Claude desktop app itself, so the check was the user's screenshot, not an automated capture
